critical_paths.name: Event ingestion
critical_paths.notes: POST /v1/events validates project tokens, applies capture policy, persists raw events to S3-compatible storage, and enqueues processing without heavy synchronous work.

critical_paths.name: Incident processing and bundle generation
critical_paths.notes: Worker jobs normalize events, group incidents, build deterministic bundles, create reproductions, evaluate alerts/webhooks, and prune retained artifacts.

critical_paths.name: Incident retrieval and lifecycle
critical_paths.notes: API routes serve incident metadata, context, bundles, reproductions, logs, and resolve/reopen lifecycle actions reused by CLI and MCP.

critical_paths.name: Local-first agent workflow
critical_paths.notes: setup, doctor, validate, process, incidents, inspect, explain, bundle, reproduce, resolve, reopen, and analyze operate on .debugbundle profile, state, events, and bundles.

critical_paths.name: Agent tool parity
critical_paths.notes: MCP tools mirror CLI/API retrieval, lifecycle, project, billing, probe, capture-policy, webhook, Slack, GitHub, and analysis capabilities through thin adapters.

critical_paths.name: Dashboard and project management
critical_paths.notes: React SPA owns authenticated project/account/billing/settings/incidents UI while business behavior remains API/package owned.

debugbundle.notes: Agent-validated profile for the DebugBundle core repo. Keep services, critical paths, and workflows aligned when architecture or public interfaces change.
